text: Science is all around us, every day. We use science and technology to make life easier. For example, electricity gives us light and heat in our homes. A machine like a washing machine uses electricity to clean our clothes. Have you ever wondered why things fall to the ground? That happens because of gravity. Gravity pulls objects down to the earth. In the kitchen, we use science too. When you boil water, it gets very hot, and the temperature rises. If you mix different foods together, you make something new to eat. Scientists do experiments to test their ideas. They watch carefully and write down the result. Sometimes an experiment helps them solve a problem. Many phones and computers use a battery for energy. Some houses also use solar panels, which use light from the sun to make electricity. Air is important for science too; we need clean air to breathe and stay healthy. Scientists study different materials, like plastic, metal, and wood, to build new things. Learning about science helps us understand the world and solve everyday problems.
